task.title: Report broken elements as JSON
task.problem: With --all-elements, --all-options and --fetch-sources a large project reports many broken recipes (assertions, missing files or elements, invalid YAML, undefined variables, missing paths, failed fetches) only as stderr lines, repeated per option set and hard to triage.
task.proposal: Add --report-broken FILE: a JSON Lines report, written atomically at the end of the run, with one record per failure (stage, element, error, BuildStream reason) and the effective toplevel option values of every option set it occurred in.
acceptance: Read, instantiation, subproject, fetch and option-set failures are recorded with stage, element, error text, BuildStream reason and the effective option sets; the same failure across option sets is one record.
The report is written atomically even when the run exits with status 2; an unwritable directory fails before searching; stdout results and stderr diagnostics are unchanged.
evidence: test_broken_report_groups_failures_with_their_option_sets and the --report-broken runs in test_fetch_sources_keeps_searching_when_one_source_cannot_be_fetched pass against BuildStream 2.8.1.
